editorial: You find yourself whisked into a grand manor, where the walls seem to echo each pulse of your own anxiety. This psychological thriller throws you into a secluded weekend with a reclusive artist, an ex-lover, an obsessive fan, and a trembling muse, each character spiraling into a dark, interconnected maze. Joaquin Phoenix carries every scene with almost no dialogue, drawing you deeper into the artist's spiraling mind while the manor itself feels like a character, suffused with striking cinematography. Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling and tense, claustrophobic atmospheres.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
